args.sql:
WITH aadr_outperformance AS (
    SELECT 
        calendaryear,
        fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance
    FROM annual_returns
    WHERE portfolioref = 'AADR'
      AND fundperf IS NOT NULL
      AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    calendaryear,
    ROUND(CAST(outperformance AS numeric), 5) AS outperformance,
    ROUND(CAST(LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS numeric), 5) AS prior_year_outperformance,
    ROUND(CAST(outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS numeric), 5) AS change
FROM aadr_outperformance
ORDER BY calendaryear;
